text: On M001 and missions generally: "The mission is working towards the goal of having you oversee and manage launches and runs, reporting to and from the commander. Improve the flightdeck system by proposing changes up the chain to the commander. And keep the cockpit well structured and maintained, to serve this goal. A messy cockpit jeopardises missions." A mission needs a goal so young pilots know their targets and do not finish early.
